_rln_notes: Stack-agnostic base. context7 = version-correct library docs for any ecosystem (kills invented APIs). serena = language-server-backed code navigation, so the agent stops grep-crawling a large repo.
GitHub (PRs, issues, CI) is recommended everywhere and installs as a plugin: claude plugin install github@claude-plugins-official
Add anything stack-specific (a database server, a browser driver) in the repo's own .mcp.json, not here.

Policy: <=5 active servers per session; a CLI beats an MCP server when it does the same job; secrets only via ${ENV_VAR}; every server that reaches sensitive data needs a row in docs/AGENT_TOOLING.md and the owner's approval.
